Privacy Policy

Effective September 22, 2026

This policy describes the current Astra iOS application. It is reviewed whenever Astra’s production persistence, analytics, Advisor processing, or service providers change.

Information Astra handles

  • Account information: Supabase user identifier, email address, and the name Apple may provide on first authorization.
  • Profile inputs: birth date, birth time, birth place, coordinates, time zone, selected goal, and current situation.
  • Derived profile: deterministic astrology, numerology, Chinese-zodiac results, and the reading produced from those results.
  • Subscription entitlement supplied by the App Store.
  • Advisor questions and up to six recent session messages, held only for the current in-app session by Astra.
  • AI service metadata: endpoint, model, token counts, estimated cost, cache-hit state, and timestamp. This metadata does not include prompts or generated text.
  • Product analytics: pseudonymous app-instance and device information plus interaction events, including onboarding completion, paywall activity, feature views, and purchase lifecycle events.

Use

Astra uses this information to authenticate the account, calculate and present the personal profile, restore access, and determine premium entitlement. Astrology is a reflective framework, not professional advice or a guarantee of outcomes.

Services and sharing

Supabase processes account authentication, hosts protected Astra backend functions, caches generated Founder/Daily/Weekly/Monthly content, and stores technical AI usage metadata. OpenAI processes Advisor questions and a limited derived interpretation profile to generate Advisor, Daily, Weekly, and Monthly content; Astra requests that responses are not stored by the provider. The interpretation profile contains derived signs, numerology, Chinese-zodiac facts, archetype, goal, and situation—not raw birth date, time, place, coordinates, or time zone.

Apple processes Sign in with Apple, App Store purchases, and birth-place search through Apple frameworks. Google Firebase Analytics processes pseudonymous usage, device, and subscription transaction events so Astra can understand onboarding completion, feature engagement, and purchase performance. Astra does not set a Firebase user ID and does not send names, email addresses, raw birth details, exact coordinates, selected goal or situation values, Advisor text, or private reading text to analytics. Astra does not sell personal information.

Storage and retention

Supabase retains account records, cached generated Founder/Daily/Weekly/Monthly content, and metadata-only AI usage rows while the account exists or until operational cleanup occurs. These user-owned rows are deleted with the account. The iOS app stores the Supabase session in Keychain and stores the completed onboarding profile and personalized Today/Forecast caches locally in account-scoped app storage. These values are detached when the user signs out, cannot be read by another signed-in Astra account, and are removed after successful account deletion.

Astra does not persist Advisor questions or responses. Firebase Analytics retains analytics data according to Astra’s configured Google Analytics retention settings; deleting an Astra account does not by itself identify and delete pseudonymous analytics already collected because Astra does not associate it with the Supabase account identifier. OpenAI may retain limited security or abuse-monitoring records according to its applicable API policies. Raw birth inputs and exact coordinates are not stored in AI caches or usage logs.

Deletion and control

Users can permanently delete an Astra account inside Profile → Delete Account. This removes the account and associated Astra cloud data that Astra is not legally required to retain. App Store subscriptions are controlled by Apple and are not cancelled by deleting an Astra account; use Manage Subscription in Profile before deletion if you want billing to stop.

Security, children, changes, and contact

Astra uses encrypted network connections and platform secure storage for session credentials. No system can guarantee absolute security. Astra is intended for adults and is not directed to children under 13. Material policy changes will receive a new effective date. Privacy questions can be sent to anghel.developr90@gmail.com.
